prompts: Create a single 16:9 in-game close-up cut-in for a hand-painted watercolor narrative adventure set in a modest 1987 northern railway station. Dish is fully visible; leave generous space around it. Soft realistic watercolor brushwork and paper texture matching a restrained illustrated winter-station interior, credible material detail, natural perspective. No writing, no labels, no interface, no arrows, no puzzle marks, no people, no cat, no hands, no evidence props, no blood, no crime imagery. This is the before-state of a three-image observation sequence; aim for simple clean composition and an easily identifiable dish footprint. Opaque background.
